sources.method: From the local Week 4 article archive (data/intel/articles/2026-w04/). SurvivorGrid was not reachable from this session, so pick share is ESPN Survivor selection % as of Wednesday; no value (EV) score this week.

MIN.note: ESPN top pick (83% ESPN Analytics / 93% Clay; future value 16th). Action Network: safety over leverage, Vikings lack future value. VSiN/PoolGenius 81%, their best remaining spot. Expect higher ownership in big-money pools.

BAL.note: ESPN: depends on ownership (84% / 91%; future value 6th); best if well under 37% in your pool. VSiN/PoolGenius 84%, but 70%+ in five more weeks. Action Network pairs it with MIN as the chalk.

SEA.note: ESPN pivot off the chalk (74% / 87%; future value 7th). VSiN/PoolGenius 73%. Backfield thin (Charbonnet, Price out).

BUF.note: ESPN leans save for later (70% / 74%; future value 8th).

GB.note: ESPN: large-pool-only contrarian play (low future value; Week 15 vs MIA is the other spot).
